name: fresh-onboard-full-flow
input: I just joined the Panviva team and my manager told me to 'get SkillForge set up.' I have no idea what that means or where to start. Can you walk me through it?
expected_output: Skill walks through all 7 steps in order, starting with the Okta group admin ask, pausing for user confirmation between steps, and ending with `skillforge init <project-name>` after asking which project.

name: init-fails-with-401
input: I ran `skillforge init panviva-core` and got a 401 Unauthorized error. What's wrong?
expected_output: Skill jumps to the error table, identifies that api_key or server_url isn't set correctly, has the user run `skillforge config get server_url` and `skillforge config get api_key`, and re-runs steps 5/6 if either is missing.

name: cli-not-found-after-install
input: I ran `pip install git+https://github.com/panviva/pv-ai-skillforge.git` and it succeeded, but when I run `skillforge --version` I get 'command not found'. I'm on Windows.
expected_output: Skill recognises the Windows PATH/Python-version mismatch path, suggests `py -m skillforge`, and flags the known `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src'` failure mode as an alternate possibility to check for.
